annotations.text:
Try the core loop

1. Today → "Triage 1 →"
2. Give "Checker notification not received" a category
3. Release gate → the unclassified rule turns green and a waiver becomes possible

Classify it as Product defect instead and the Jira rule fails, because that signature has no Jira link.

Keys 1–7 switch views.

What changed in the UX

• Today leads with a verdict sentence and one next action, not six equal KPIs
• Failure analysis → Triage: a split view where categorising is one click, feeding the gate live
• Run comparison moved to Runs (tick two rows)
• Colour is only a signal light; normal = dim, anomalies glow
